## Bog Kraken (CR 19)

A towering, tentacled spire of death rises from the murky swamp, covered in bony growths, lichen and moss. Its horrid maw opens and you see no end to the rows of its terrible teeth.  

**XP** 204,800  
NE Gargantuan magical beast (aquatic)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision; Perception +16  


**Defense**


**AC** 37, touch 6, flat-footed 37 (+31 natural, -4 size)  
**hp** 440 (20d10+240)  
**Fort** +23, **Ref** +14, **Will** +11  
**DR** 10/magic and piercing; **Immune** disease, mind-affecting effects, poison; **Resist** acid 30, fire 30  


**Offense**


**Speed** 10 ft., swim 40 ft.  
**Melee** bite +32 (6d10+15/19-20 plus grab), 8 tentacles +27 (2d6+7/19-20 plus grab)  
**Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 20 ft. (40 ft. with tentacles)  
**Special Attacks** biting tentacles, constrict (tentacles, 2d6+15), entrancing lure, swallow whole (special, AC 25, 35 hp)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 40, **Dex** 10, **Con** 33, **Int** 4, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 9  
**Base Atk** +20; **CMB** +39 (+43 grapple); **CMD** 49 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Blind-Fight, Critical Focus, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception, Stealth), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Weapon Focus (bite), [Lightning Reflexes](../../rules/feats/lightning-reflexes.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Lightning Reflexes.*  
**Skills** Perception +16, Stealth +8, Swim +27; Racial Modifiers +8 Stealth  
Languages Aquan, Common (can’t speak)  
**SQ** amphibious, tenacious grapple  


**Special Abilities**


**Biting Tentacles (Ex)** Bog kraken’s tentacles end with secondary mouths consisting of four flaps lined with teeth. The tentacle attacks of a bog kraken count as a bite for all advantageous purposes (like the weapon focus feat) and deal bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.  

**Entrancing Lure (Su)** Each of bog kraken’s tentacles is equipped with a dangling, glowing bulb not unlike an anglerfish’s lure. When the bog kraken succeeds at a grapple check to start or maintain the grapple with its tentacle, the grappled creature has to succeed at a DC 31 Will save or be dazed for 1 round. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Obliterating Bite (Ex)** A creature swallowed whole by the bog kraken automatically takes 24d10+60 damage, as if hit by a critical hit from its bite with a x4 multiplier. This damage ignores hardness and damage reduction. If the creature is brought below 50% of its maximum hit points by this damage, it has to succeed at a DC 35 Fortitude save or die as if it was a victim of a coup de grace attempt. If the creature dies, it has to succeed at a DC 35 Fortitude save or its body and equipment are utterly destroyed. Only true resurrection can bring such a victim back to life, and only artifacts and other items immune to conventional damage may be recovered from the slain beast’s innards. The save DCs are Strength-based.  

**Tenacious Grapple (Ex)** A bog kraken does not gain the grappled condition if it grapples a foe.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any swamp  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** standard
